This includes referrals into directly bookable services as well as referral assessment triage requests which can be further split by specialty, provider and priority (2WW, Ugenrt, Routine). ","textStyle":{"fontFamily":"Arial","fontSize":"12pt"}},{"value":"The following analysis illustrates the E-Referral activity for all patients registered to a Gloucestershire GP Practice (11M). ","textStyle":{"fontFamily":"Arial","fontSize":"12pt"}}]},{"textRuns":[{"value":""}]},{"textRuns":[{"value":""}]},{"textRuns":[{"value":"Referral Assessment Service ","textStyle":{"fontWeight":"bold","fontFamily":"Arial","fontSize":"14pt"}}]},{"textRuns":[{"value":" [CCG_Sandbox].[dbo].[Referral_Assessment_Service_Total]","textStyle":{"fontSize":"13.3333px"}}]},{"textRuns":[{"value":""}]},{"textRuns":[{"value":"The Referral Assessment Service (RAS) allows providers to assess the Clinical Referral Information from the GP/referrer without the need for an appointment being booked and decide on the most appropriate onward clinical pathway.
